data.name: RIDGERUNNERS
data.detailed_description:
THE MOUNTAIN IS THE RACETRACK

RIDGERUNNERS is a first-person racing game about building enormous speed across procedural mountains. Press one button to remove ground friction: going downhill accelerates you, while a clean landing carries that speed into the next slope.

Pass the checkpoints in order, but choose your own route. Dive through valleys, carve across mountain faces, fly over hills, or risk a more dangerous direct path. The fastest route is the one you can survive.

MASTER YOUR MOMENTUM

Every movement system is designed to work together:

  • Ski to remove ground friction and build speed downhill.

  • Carve across slopes without losing your speed.

  • Air-strafe to steer while flying to prepare your landing.

  • Rocket-jump for explosive bursts of speed at the cost of health.

  • Disc-launch enemies and environmental features to boost your speed.

  • Grapple to use your environment to slingshot yourself.

  • Hammer Slam to trade verticality for more speed.

  • Jetpack to extend jumps, clear ridges, and aim for the perfect landing.

INFINITE POSSIBILITIES.

Every mountain is a vast 6 km × 6 km playground shaped from up to 7 distinct biomes. Carve through alpine snow, rolling meadows, flooded lakelands, red-rock mesas, sweeping dunes, glacial ice, and volcanic wastes, each introducing different terrain, hazards, and opportunities to gain speed.

Checkpoints tell you where to go, but never how to get there. Scout the landscape, discover faster routes, and return to your favorite mountains to perfect lines that once seemed impossible. The terrain, weather, and hazards reset with every attempt, so practice pays off and every race is fair.

Take on the full Ridge course, chase a quick finish in Sprint, or ride the shared daily mountain alongside the rest of the world. Each format has its own times, ghosts, medals, and global leaderboard.

THE MOUNTAIN FIGHTS BACK

Speed is only useful if you can stay alive. Thread through solid forests, avoid lava and crevasses, outrun hunter drones, destroy sentry turrets, dodge falling boulders, and decide whether dangerous weather is an obstacle or a shortcut.

Storm winds can bend your route. Snow squalls can erase your view. Thermal columns and geysers can launch you skyward if you enter them on the right line.

RACE THE CLOCK, GHOSTS, AND OTHER RIDERS

  • Chase personal bests and global seed leaderboards.

  • Race against your own best run or another rider’s ghost.

  • Study complete runs in the replay theater with first-person, follow, and free cameras.

  • See and talk to other riders exploring the same live seed.

  • Compete in live races, hunts, and random sprint rounds.

Prefer to ride alone? Every course, biome, hazard, ghost, and leaderboard challenge remains fully playable as a single-player experience.

LEARN THE LINE. SCRAP THE RUN. GO AGAIN.

Use the movement school to learn each mechanic, or enter practice mode to drill individual checkpoint legs. Death ends the attempt, but every crash teaches you something: a cleaner landing, a safer ridge, or a line nobody else has tried.

The mountain is waiting. Find the fastest way down.

data.short_description: RIDGERUNNERS is a first-person mountain racer. Press one button to remove ground friction, build speed downhill, and fly between checkpoints using gravity and your weapons. Find the fastest route, race ghosts and live players, and climb the global leaderboard.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 or AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X, 2 GB VRAM, OpenGL 3.3 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard audio device
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required. Internet connection required only for online features.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580, 4 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard audio device

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 64-bit, SteamOS 3.0, or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 or AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X, 2 GB VRAM, OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA, PulseAudio, or PipeWire-compatible audio
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system required. Keyboard and mouse required. Internet connection required only for online features.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 64-bit, SteamOS 3.0, or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580, 4 GB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA, PulseAudio, or PipeWire-compatible audio
  • Additional Notes: Up-to-date Mesa or proprietary graphics drivers recommended.
